name: Cursor
tagline: Because you were going to look at your cursor anyway.
description: A halo round your mouse cursor in the colour of your build: green while it passes, amber while a pull request waits, red while it's broken, breathing while it runs. The real cursor is never touched — it's a click-through window that follows the mouse, so nothing needs putting back when you quit. A reference consumer of the Greenlight SDK, in which the whole integration is about twenty lines.
